name: How long does a typical plumbing repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical plumbing repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a plumbing repair depends entirely on the nature and severity of the problem. Simple fixes, such as replacing a faucet washer or clearing a minor drain clog, might take an hour or less. More involved repairs, like fixing a slab leak or replacing a water heater, could take several hours or even a full day. Our plumbers will provide an estimated timeframe after diagnosing the issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary; simple fixes take an hour or less, while complex issues may take several hours or a full day. An estimate is provided after diagnosis.
